name: SamurAI Shield :: Java library (jar) patch
description: Input contract for playbooks/java_library_patch_with_evidence.yml (repo: prfsouto/samurai-aap-playbooks). Replaces a vulnerable Java library (.jar) found anywhere inside SEARCH_ROOT — a server's own lib/ or a webapp's WEB-INF/lib, unified — via a rename-to-backup + replace + restart cutover with automatic rollback. HOSTNAMES is auto-filled by SamurAI Shield from the governed asset and hidden from the operator form. IMPORTANT: enable 'Prompt on launch -> Extra variables' (ask_variables_on_launch) on the Job Template so the engine's governed HOSTNAMES overrides the survey's blank default instead of being discarded.

spec.question_description: Single host, IP, or space/comma-separated list. Filled automatically by SamurAI Shield from the selected asset — do not type it by hand.
Absolute path of the directory tree to search for the jar (any Java application's root — not Tomcat-specific).
Glob of the jar to find, e.g. "log4j-core-*.jar". Never a single path — the same jar can exist in more than one place.
The systemd unit to restart after the jar swap, so the JVM's classloader picks up the new jar.
Check lists every matching jar under the search root, read-only. Apply downloads, verifies, backs up and replaces each match, then restarts the service.
Required when ACTION=Apply: the exact replacement jar.
Required when ACTION=Apply: the jar is never installed without a matching checksum.
Required when ACTION=Apply: the exact filename the replacement jar is installed as (may differ from the old name, e.g. log4j-core-2.17.1.jar replacing log4j-core-2.14.1.jar).
Base directory on the target where the structured evidence files are written.
